name: Florida Ebike Rentals
tagline: Find e-bike rentals, guided tours and beach cruisers across Florida
description: Florida Ebike Rentals is a free directory of electric bike rental shops, guided e-bike tours and beach cruiser rentals across Florida, from 30A and the Emerald Coast to the Florida Keys.

map._comment: Tile provider for the site's maps. OpenStreetMap's own tile.openstreetmap.org is NOT usable here: its usage policy forbids heavy use of the volunteer-run servers and requires an identifying Referer. Carto's basemaps are keyless and permit use with attribution. For higher volume move to a keyed provider (MapTiler, Stadia, Thunderforest) by pasting its URL template below, including the key.
